_doc: City → skin assignment (M1-14, DESIGN-SYSTEM §3.3). Source of truth for the [data-city] skin selectors in design/beta/tokens.css — regenerate with `python3 design/beta/tools/skins.py` (also copies tokens.css to beta/assets/). Keys are the generator's page keys (beta/data/manifest.json). A key ending in '/*' is a prefix (regional skin). Cities not listed get the neutral default skin.
